string.text: Our territory - the base of the Duty faction. We're very picky about who we let into our home. Remember that!

So that ghoul sent you? Figures. He seems like a serious bastard, yet he's running errands for every piece of scum in the Zone. 
 
Alright, follow the fence. When you hit the stream, look for the small building. That's where your stupid eye is. I wouldn't take that shit even if you paid me! 
 
Oh, and say hello to Phil for me. Tell him we'll be meeting again shortly.
